$comment: Capability registry: one entry per parity row. States: `not-live` (nothing proven yet); `local` (works end to end on the local Canton sandbox stack with the real ops process, proven by every path in `evidence`; not yet on Noders DevNet or a hosted URL); `live` (on DevNet and the hosted URL: its gate has passed and `acceptanceRow` names a row in docs/plan/acceptance.md). The `capabilities-evidence` invariant fails on `local` or `live` without evidence, and on `live` without its acceptance row.
